root_cause_hypothesis: The Interpreter expands a subject-removal request into CLEAR deltas on subject.count and subject.pose_action in addition to the annotated target subject.description. The Validator only rejects CLEAR on pinned paths (validation.clear_requires_unpinned_path), so the two unpinned paths are accepted and their values and Resolution records are removed. Observed at rep1 t5 and rep2 t3.
impact: Blocks Gate A outright: L1 unauthorized_fields_unchanged 42/44 with 8 violation checks, summary.gate_a_blocked=true; also contributes 4 of the 56 out_of_scope deltas and zeroes missing_decision_recall for s08-pin-unpin-001 rep2.

root_cause_hypothesis: The frozen conflict predicates match English vocabularies (enclosed environment modes, open-air locations, natural light terms, photo/non-photo style terms, wide-framing terms) while the Interpreter stores Chinese values (摄影棚环境 / 海边沙滩 / 室内环境 / 自然光照明 / 写实摄影 / 画面整体要水彩画的质感 / 远景构图 / 全景 / wide_shot). Every predicate returns False, so all 12 expected conflicts are missed including 6 blocking hard conflicts after which the system reached ready and generated.
impact: Conflict Detection 0/12 with 6 severe failures; drives all 6 system_b unauthorized_addition hits and 5 of the 13 failed turns (the blocked clarification_answer turns in the three s04 cases) because the cases reach ready at t1 instead of asking.

root_cause_hypothesis: assess() is called from four sites (intent_engine/engine.py lines 62 and 100, workflow/review.py lines 322 and 563) without the execution_context argument, so execution_conflict.framing_aspect_mismatch short-circuits to False at decision_policy.py line 291 before the framing vocabulary is even consulted. The 1024x1024 ExecutionRevision exists in the session (workflow/service.py line 150) but is never threaded into policy evaluation.
impact: The execution-conflict rule is dead code in production; 6 of the 12 expected conflicts are unreachable. Currently latent behind the Chinese-framing value issue, but it would still fail after a vocabulary-only fix.

root_cause_hypothesis: Two concretization habits with no user basis: (a) singular noun phrases always yield SET subject.count=1 with resolution user_specified although the annotation lists subject.count in paths_must_remain_unset; (b) locative descriptions are absorbed into environment.location (壁炉边 in s02-missing-core-001, 沙发 in s09-multiturn-002) although the annotation keeps environment.location unset and blocking.
impact: 46 of 56 out_of_scope deltas and 47 of 58 must_remain_unset violations come from SET subject.count; the environment.location variant removes a blocking missing decision, causing 8 of 13 uncovered blocking points and, in s02/s09, the wrong turn outcome that ends in state-machine rejection.

root_cause_hypothesis: A user instruction to keep 构图和风格 unchanged is expanded into PIN deltas covering composition.framing, environment.location, environment.mode, lighting.character, style.primary and (rep2) subject.pose_action, while the annotation authorises PIN only on composition.framing and style.primary. PIN does not change values, so no L1 invariant breaks, but 12 out-of-scope deltas are recorded and the unpin turn then fails with validation.unpin_requires_pinned_path in rep2.
impact: Lowers L2 delta precision (13 of 56 out_of_scope deltas: 7 in rep1 + 6 in rep2) and introduces an avoidable validation issue; no state-correctness impact.

root_cause_hypothesis: Twelve LLM calls failed with provider.timeout (interpreter 9, feedback_engine 2, i.e. 3 of them inside adapter retries) with no failure on Baseline A. The adapter exhausts its two frozen retries and the product records a provider.* issue and continues with an empty intent instead of any orchestration-level degradation, so a first-turn timeout permanently loses the user's message and cascades.
impact: Four uncovered blocking decisions, two whole-case failures (s09-multiturn-002 r1, s05-delegate-explicit-002 both repetitions) and the asymmetry between repetitions that weakens Go condition 5. Not a product logic defect; the protocol forbids external retries.

root_cause_hypothesis: evaluate_preservation pairs every modification turn with the nearest earlier prompt-bearing turn, and when the modification turn produced no prompt it records kept=0 and lists every previously hit keyword group as lost. All 35 lost groups recorded for system_b come from exactly those 10 no-prompt turns, which are valid clarification requests or PIN-protected rejections rather than content loss; across the 23 comparable pairs system_b retains 47 of 47 groups, identical to Baseline A (87/87).
impact: The headline system_b preservation 0.691 versus baseline_a 1.0 is not usable as drift evidence; any Step 07 comparison under the same metric reproduces the artifact. Note the metric follows the frozen protocol text literally, so the correction requires a new protocol/metric version rather than a silent implementation change.
suggested_fix_target: evaluation/metrics/prompt.py (new metric version gated on a new protocol version)

root_cause_hypothesis: Protocol section 3 maps each scripted turn kind to a fixed entry point (user_message/clarification_answer to submit_message, image_feedback/accept to submit_feedback) regardless of the session state the product actually reached. When the product deviates from expected_outcome, the scripted turn is rejected by the frozen v0.2 state machine; the runner records flow_deviation and keeps the failure in the denominator but does not route the user text to the entry allowed by the current state. Each of the 11 invalid_state rejections is preceded by a product deviation, so the rejections are a downstream symptom, not the root cause.
impact: 13 failed turns in 11 of 44 System B case runs (25%). No metric is inflated or hidden because failures stay in the denominator, but failure classification and the comparability of the interruption cost are affected; a new protocol version is the compliant route.
suggested_fix_target: evaluation/runner.py (only under a new protocol version)

root_cause_hypothesis: For pair_018 (s08-pin-unpin-001 t4) the reviewer preferred the Baseline image that deleted the PIN-protected cat and scored edit_success baseline_a=5 / system_b=2, while the frozen annotation states that under PIN protection not deleting the cat is the expected behaviour and that edit_success is judged against the annotation. The Step 04 blind package exposed the per-dimension focus but not the case notes that carry this instruction.
impact: Biases the headline Edit Success comparison (one of ten pairs, and the largest single-pair gap) and the User Preference count by one. Single reviewer, n=10 paired slots, so the L4 margins carry no statistical power.
suggested_fix_target: evaluation/image_review.py (review UI guidance; do not rescore the existing 29 pairs)

root_cause_hypothesis: The prompt.unauthorized_addition guard checks clause provenance (every clause must bind to the confirmed Intent plus execution revision), not whether conflicting content leaked into the prompt. Every clause in these cases traces to user-confirmed Intent, so guard_triggered=0 is correct, yet the report emits guard_bypassed=1 whenever must_not_mention keywords are present, implying a bypassed guard.
impact: Documentation/labeling only; no score or aggregation is affected. The 6 system_b keyword hits are real and are already attributed to the conflict-detection defect FC-P2.

root_cause_hypothesis: Baseline A completed 44 of 44 case runs with zero LLM or image call failures and no L1/L2 surface (both are not_applicable by protocol). Its only measurable deficits are textual: 2 unauthorized_addition keyword hits that mirror system_b in the same conflict cases, and 2 missing_data L3 records from s06-delegate-vague-002, where the annotation intentionally provides no prompt expectations. This entry records that Baseline A is a valid reference, not a failure subject.
impact: Confirms the A-side of every comparison is not itself failing; keeps the drifts observed in system_b attributable to system_b rather than to a broken reference.
